name: Revenge Heart
source:
A baffling request arrived at the doorstep of the professional hitman Kevin.
"In four days from now, I want you to kill me with a bullet through the heart."

Enticed by a fee of 100 million, Kevin accepted the job—only to find himself hunted by the Ludwig Family, a mafia syndicate with their sights set on the client: a young boy named Luca, whose heart is their target.

Eric, the charismatic center of the popular idol group "Mystic Comet", suffers from a severe heart condition, and only way to save him is with a heart transplant from Luca, his younger twin brother.

"Once the concert is over, my heart is going to be harvested and given to Eric. That’s why I ran away."
"Hey, Kevin, help me get my revenge."

Seeing a reflection of his own past in Luca's plight, Kevin resolves to help the boy carry out his vengeance.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12032]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
一个莫名其妙的请求来到了职业杀手凯文的家门口。
“四天后，我要你用一颗子弹穿过心脏杀死我。”

在一亿报酬的诱惑下，凯文接受了这份工作，却发现自己遭到了黑手党集团路德维希家族的追捕，他们的目标是客户：一个名叫卢卡的小男孩，他的心是他们的目标。

人气偶像团体“神秘彗星”的魅力中心埃里克患有严重的心脏病，唯一的方法就是接受双胞胎弟弟卢卡的心脏移植手术。

“演唱会一结束，我的心就会被收割，送给Eric，所以我才逃跑。”
“嘿，凯文，帮我报仇吧。”

凯文在卢卡的困境中看到了自己过去的影子，决定帮助这个男孩报仇。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12032]Novelgame[/url]]
